headline: Euro Falls on Rate Expectations
summary: The dollar ends March with its best monthly performance since September 2022, while the euro posts its worst quarter since 2024, with Brent above $105 per barrel.
why: The euro is the currency of the euro area, and its value against the dollar affects European importers, exporters and inflation expectations. Oil prices feed directly into those dynamics.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Investor concerns about the global economy and rate expectations have pushed the euro lower against the dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investor concerns about the global economy and a Middle East conflict that pushed Brent above $105 per barrel shifted flows toward the dollar. The supply shock raises slowdown risks for the euro area.
